newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt airport police make largest ever gold haul.
newsitem.headline: Egypt airport police make largest ever gold haul.

text.p: Egyptian airport officials said on Tuesday they had seized 100 kg (220 lb) of gold hidden in eight tractor engine cylinders.
Airport sources said police found the gold while searching an Egyptian man's luggage in the "nothing to declare" customs zone when he was entering the country.
The man did not have any documents proving he owned the gold, which is worth an estimated $1.2 million.

It is believed to be the largest amount of gold to be confiscated by Egyptian police. The previous largest haul of smuggled gold was discovered a few years when police confiscated 40 kg of the precious metal.
